items.raw_excerpt: A Dutch scientist has won the Ig Nobel prize for conducting a study that involved burying around 1,000 pairs of underpants and digging them up two months later. Marcel van der Heijden, a soil scientist at the University of Zurich, shared this year’s Ig Nobel for soil science with three colleagues. The annual prizes, a parody counterpart to the Nobels, reward research that “first makes people laugh and then makes them think.” Volunteers buried identical cotton underpants across more than...
items.summary_en: A soil scientist from the University of Zurich won an Ig Nobel prize for an experiment where volunteers buried 1,000 pairs of cotton underpants. The team dug them up two months later to study how different soils break down organic material. The annual Ig Nobel rewards research that first makes people laugh, then think.
items.summary_ko: 취리히 대학 토양과학자가 자원봉사자들과 함께 속옷 1000켤레를 묻었다가 2개월 후 파내는 실험으로 아이 노벨상을 받았다. 이 실험은 토양 유형에 따른 유기물 분해 속도를 비교하기 위해 진행되었다. 아이 노벨상은 먼저 웃음 짓게 하고 생각하게 만드는 연구에 수여된다.
items.title_en: Dutch scientist wins Ig Nobel for burying 1,000 underpants in soil study
